summary: 3 film announcements, 2 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Supermax
film.announcement: Jason Clarke joins the action-thriller as a key cast member. The film is being developed by Amazon MGM Studios and Miramax.

film.title: Spring Breakers 2
film.announcement: Bella Thorne has been tapped by producers to write, direct, and star in the sequel after they saw her directorial debut.

film.title: Artificial
film.announcement: Luca Guadagnino's OpenAI-backed film with Monica Barbaro in the cast. The project has been in development with Timothée Chalamet also attached.

tv.title: Boston Blue
tv.announcement: Will Estes, an alum of 'Blue Bloods,' is reprising his role on the new series.

tv.title: Heated Rivalry
tv.announcement: Season 2 casting has been announced, with the author of the original work responding to negative reactions to the cast selections.
